lines.2: I have a childhood friend who wakes me up every morning.
lines.3: That makes me a pretty lucky guy.
lines.4: My childhood friend lives nearby, is a real busybody, and even cooks for me sometimes.
lines.5: 「Come on, wake up, kid. It's morning.」
lines.6: ...Now, this childhood friend of mine is...
lines.10: I haul my sluggish body upright and climb out of bed.
lines.12: 「Mm-hm. I'm fine! Leo Tsushima is officially up and at 'em.」
lines.13: 「I dunno, you look pretty suspicious. Don't go back to sleep.」
lines.15: 「Or I'll have my way with you.」
lines.18: 「See you at school, then. I'm heading on ahead.」
lines.19: I'm a second-year at a private school.
lines.20: I used to get into fights, but these days I keep my nose clean and enjoy an ordinary school life.
lines.21: I do all right in my classes, too.
lines.23: I head downstairs and turn on the TV.
lines.24: The world news is as grim as ever, but...
lines.25: 「Our next story. In Tokyo, buildings with rooftop trees are being introduced to combat the heat-island effect...」
lines.27: Me, I'm a little depressed because we're getting our midterm results back today.
lines.28: The breakfast Subaru made for me is waiting on the table.
lines.29: I keep telling him I'm fine on my own in the mornings. What a busybody.
lines.31: Next stop is the Kanisawa house next door.
lines.32: I greet Mrs. Kanisawa as she sweeps the front entrance.
